themes_detail.label: Dead Animal Cleanup Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Dead animal complaints spiked 700% THIS WEEK to 11 complaints vs. 1.4 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 8.66), suggesting either a disease event, wildlife die-off, or systemic collection failures in CD 211.
evidence: 11 dead animal complaints filed last week vs. 1.4 weekly average (700% increase, z-score 8.66)
This represents the sharpest statistical anomaly in the dataset
Aligns with community board's standing request for animal and pest control enforcement
reporting_angles: Interview DSNY and Parks Enforcement on surge cause—disease outbreak, inadequate collection routes, or seasonal pattern?
Canvass Morris Park and Pelham Parkway streets to document locations and conditions of reported carcasses
Contact NYC Health to determine if any zoonotic or public health alert is in effect

themes_detail.label: Overgrown Trees and Branch Hazards
themes_detail.summary: Overgrown tree and branch complaints surged 515% THIS WEEK to 10 complaints vs. 1.6 weekly average (z-score: 7.54), indicating either deferred Parks maintenance or post-storm damage in CD 211.
evidence: 10 overgrown tree complaints filed THIS WEEK vs. 1.6 weekly average (515% increase, z-score 7.54)
Second-highest statistical anomaly in current dataset
Matches repeating community board request for park and street tree maintenance
reporting_angles: Check recent weather events (storms, heavy winds) that may have triggered complaints
Request Parks Department response time data and tree-pruning schedule for CD 211
Document specific problem locations (Pelham Parkway itself?) and interview residents about safety concerns

themes_detail.label: Building Code Violations Spike
themes_detail.summary: Building and use violations jumped 339% LAST WEEK to 17 complaints vs. 3.9 weekly average (z-score: 6.47), suggesting increased illegal conversions, overcrowding, or construction non-compliance across CD 211.
evidence: 17 building/use complaints filed last week vs. 3.9 weekly average (339% increase, z-score 6.47)
310 total DOB permits filed in last 90 days (165 alterations, 95 new buildings) suggests active construction activity
Aligns with community board's recurring zoning and land use requests
reporting_angles: Cross-reference 311 complaints with DOB permits to identify non-compliant alteration projects
Interview DOB inspectors about enforcement capacity and complaint processing backlog in this district
Investigate whether the completed ULURP projects (Bronx Metro-North parcels, St. Raymond demapping) are generating conversion pressures

themes_detail.label: For-Hire Vehicle Abuse
themes_detail.summary: For-hire vehicle complaints (Uber, Lyft, local car services) surged 344% TWO WEEKS AGO to 5 complaints vs. 1.1 weekly average (z-score: 6.46), indicating congestion or predatory TNC behavior in Morris Park/Pelham Parkway.
evidence: 5 for-hire vehicle complaints filed 2 weeks ago vs. 1.1 weekly average (344% increase, z-score 6.46)
Spike occurred 2 weeks ago, now showing some regression (less acute than this week's spikes)
No recent TLC or transit authority news mentions in dataset suggests under-reported story
reporting_angles: Interview residents and bodega owners about specific complaints—illegal pickups, double-parking, noise, pricefixing?
Request TLC data on complaints, licenses issued, and driver conduct violations in CD 211
Determine whether spike correlates with service gaps at nearby Metro-North or subway stations

themes_detail.label: Consumer Complaints Double
themes_detail.summary: Consumer complaints doubled THIS WEEK to 9 complaints vs. 4.0 weekly average (125% increase, z-score: 3.78), potentially indicating fraud, false advertising, or service non-delivery by local businesses.
evidence: 9 consumer complaints filed THIS WEEK vs. 4.0 weekly average (125% increase, z-score 3.78)
Moderate but statistically significant spike with clear upward direction
No granular data available on complaint type (broadline complaint category)
reporting_angles: Request detail from DOC (Department of Consumer Affairs) on THIS WEEK's 9 complaints—are they from same business or scattered?
Identify if complaints cluster around construction trades, food service, or online retail
Monitor for sustained pattern vs. one-week anomaly
